title: The long road to Malapert
purpose: Teach map distance on the Moon: the official place names, the straight-line distance from the pole to Mons Malapert, and why the drivable road is far longer.

beats.label: model
beats.credit: USGS / IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature · great-circle distance
beats.line: About {straight} km in a straight line

beats.label: model
beats.sub: The game's road and its stops are fiction

captions: Places on the Moon have official names, kept on a public map.
Mons Malapert is a real mountain about {straight} km from the south pole.
That is almost three marathons laid end to end.
But a rover cannot drive straight over craters and steep slopes.
A road on gentle ground is about {road} km long.
ends_on: The straight line is never the road. Pack for the road you will actually drive.
